notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Delina.
description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Coretapper that is tapped and attacking.
Activate a Coretapper token's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
If you control any other Coretapper tokens, you may repeat step 4 as desired for each of them.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
